description: Get detailed information about a Memorystore for Valkey backup.

name.description: Required. Instance backup resource name using the form: `projects/{project_id}/locations/{location_id}/backupCollections/{backup_collection_id}/backups/{backup_id}`

name: get_backup

BackupFile.description: Backup is consisted of multiple backup files.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the backup file was created.

sizeBytes.description: Output only. Size of the backup file in bytes.

EncryptionInfo.description: EncryptionInfo describes the encryption information of a cluster.

x-google-enum-descriptions: Encryption type not specified. Defaults to GOOGLE_DEFAULT_ENCRYPTION.
The data is encrypted at rest with a key that is fully managed by Google. No key version will be populated. This is the default state.
The data is encrypted at rest with a key that is managed by the customer. KMS key versions will be populated.

kmsKeyPrimaryState.description: Output only. The state of the primary version of the KMS key perceived by the system. This field is not populated in backups.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The default value. This value is unused.
The KMS key is enabled and correctly configured.
Permission denied on the KMS key.
The KMS key is scheduled to be destroyed.
Billing is disabled for the project.

kmsKeyVersions.description: Output only. KMS key versions that are being used to protect the data at-rest.

lastUpdateTime.description: Output only. The most recent time when the encryption info was updated.

backupFiles.description: Output only. List of backup files of the backup.

backupType.description: Output only. Type of the backup.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the backup was created.

encryptionInfo.description: Output only. Encryption information of the backup.

expireTime.description: Output only. The time when the backup will expire.

instance.description: Output only. Instance resource path of this backup.

instanceUid.description: Output only. Instance uid of this backup.

name.description: Identifier. Full resource path of the backup. the last part of the name is the backup id with the following format: [YYYYMMDDHHMMSS]_[Shorted Instance UID] OR customer specified while backup instance. Example: 20240515123000_1234

nodeType.description: Output only. Node type of the instance.

replicaCount.description: Output only. Number of replicas for the instance.

shardCount.description: Output only. Number of shards for the instance.

state.description: Output only. State of the backup.
x-google-enum-descriptions: The backup is active to be used.
The backup is currently suspended due to reasons like project deletion, billing account closure, etc.

totalSizeBytes.description: Output only. Total size of the backup in bytes.

uid.description: Output only. System assigned unique identifier of the backup.
